{{Quote|Sir, the Elders are attempting to contact us, telling us to stand down and surrender ourselves for punishment for blasphemy.''"<br />"''So amusing.|The communications officer and Vyn Holpur|<ref name="Allies" />}}
A [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] '''communications officer''' served aboard the [[ChaseMaster]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] ''[[Starstalker]]'' under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vyn Holpur]] in the [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith Tribe's]] [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|fleet]] around [[44 ABY]]. During a [[Mission to the Maw|mission]] to forge an alliance with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity [[Abeloth]], the ''Starstalker'' received orders to retrieve a strong, [[Wintrium|glass-like material]] from the sacred [[Fountain of Ancients]] on [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]]. However, the Fountain was protected by [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinians]], and during the [[Violation|following skirmish]] the [[Communications officer/Legends|communications officer]] received a signal from the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Council of Elders (Klatooinian)|Elders]], ordering the Sith to surrender. The [[Officer/Legends|officer]] then discovered that the Klatooinians were contacting the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] for assistance in protecting the Fountain, something the Hutts were bound by [[Treaty of Vontor|treaty]] to give. Holpur was unconcerned by the prospect, but the Hutts soon arrived and captured the Sith. In the ensuing hearing, Holpur and his entire crew, including the communications officer, were sentenced to [[Death/Legends|death]] for violating the Fountain.

==Biography==
{{Quote|They're sending out a distress signal. They're trying to contact the Hutts to come protect them.|The communications officer|<ref name="Allies" />}}
A [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Communications officer/Legends|communications officer]] was born on<ref name="Allies" /> the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. By [[44 ABY]], the [[Officer/Legends|officer]] had joined the [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|Sith armada]],<ref name="Allies" /> the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]'s newly-formed [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]].<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Omen">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]''</ref> In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the officer was chosen to be a part of the fleet sent under the command of [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Sarasu Taalon]] to ally with [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] for a [[Mission to the Maw|mission]] to force the powerful [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] being [[Abeloth]] to cooperate with the Tribe. During the mission, the communications officer served aboard the [[ChaseMaster]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] ''[[Starstalker]]'', under the command of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vyn Holpur]]. After convincing Skywalker to join them by pretending that their mission was to destroy Abeloth, the Sith traveled to the planet [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]] to await Skywalker's friend, [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], who was to provide an [[Rockhound|asteroid tug]] for assistance in navigating [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]], where Abeloth lived. However, Skywalker and Taalon soon decided to wait for Calrissian just outside the Maw, and Taalon convinced Skywalker to let him leave two frigates&mdash;the ''Starstalker'' and the ''[[Winged Dagger]]''&mdash;behind, under the premise that they were to wait for Calrissian in case any difficulties arose. Taalon revealed his true orders to Captain [[Leeha Faal]] of the ''Winged Dagger'', which she passed on to the communications officer's captain, Holpur&mdash;Taalon wanted them to obtain samples of the strong, [[Glass/Legends|glass]]-like material [[wintrium]] from the sacred [[Fountain of Ancients|Fountain of the Hutt Ancients]] on Klatooine.<ref name="Allies" />

After the rest of the fleet departed Klatooine, Holpur and his crew began to carry out their [[Violation|mission]]. The ''Starstalker'' was soon hailed by the [[Council of Elders (Klatooinian)|Klatooinian Council of Elders]]; the communications officer received their signal and reported to Holpur that the Elders wanted the Sith to cease their actions and submit themselves to the Klatooinian government for penalty for their sacrilege. Holpur found that to be humorous, but requested that the officer patch through the message anyway. The officer did so, and soon after discovered that the Klatooinians were sending a distress signal to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], calling for their assistance in the defense of the Fountain; the officer then reported the finding to Holpur. Holpur was unconcerned by the development, however, and explained to the officer that he believed that the Hutts&mdash;in spite of the [[Treaty of Vontor|treaty]] that bound them to the protection of the Fountain in return for the Klatooinians' perpetual [[Slavery/Legends|servitude]]&mdash;were still too weakened by the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] to provide an adequate defense. Holpur was proven wrong, however, as the Hutts soon arrived and captured the Sith. The entire Sith crews of the ''Starstalker'' and ''Winged Dagger'' were brought to a hearing, and Faal lied that Holpur and his crew had acted of their own accord. The communications officer, Holpur, and the rest of the ''Starstalker''{{'s}} crew were then sentenced to [[Death/Legends|death]] for their violation of the Fountain.<ref name="Allies" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Copy, sir.|The communications officer, to Vyn Holpur|<ref name="Allies" />}}
The communications officer reported instantly to Holpur as new issues arose during their mission to retrieve wintrium from the Fountain. When Holpur ordered the Sith to patch through the Klatooinian Elders' message, the communications officer did so immediately.<ref name="Allies" />

==Powers and abilities==
The officer was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and a member of the Sith Tribe from Kesh. The officer knew how to work and control a communications station, a task the Sith undertook aboard the ChaseMaster frigate ''Starstalker''.<ref name="Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
This Sith communications officer first appeared briefly in [[Christie Golden]]'s [[2010]] novel, ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]'', the fifth installment in the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series. In the novel, the officer's [[Gender/Legends|gender]] and [[Species/Legends|species]] are unspecified.
